newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine oil prices seen remaining stable.
newsitem.headline: Philippine oil prices seen remaining stable.

text.p: The Philippines Energy Regulatory Board said on Tuesday that domestic oil prices would not be immediately affected by the increase in global crude costs caused by the U.S. missile attack against Iraq.

"As of this time, there is no immediate effect yet but if crude prices continue to increase and Singapore posted prices follow the upward trend, then there will be an increase in pump prices," Bayani Faylona, chairman of the state agency, told reporters.
Faylona said that last month Singapore postings had been on a downtrend which may drive domestic prices down this month.
The ERB adjusts oil prices on or before the third Monday of each month using an automatic formula based on Singapore postings.
